overview_description.description:
Prospa provides unsecured business loans to small businesses in Australia and is Australian owned and operated. Using a smart proprietary technology platform and a simple online application process, Prospa gives small business owners a fast and easy way to access finance, and has already helped thousands of Australian small businesses. 

In 2015 Prospa won the Deloitte Tech Fast 50 with 6071% growth over three years, making it the fastest growing technology company in Australia, and the third fastest in Asia. Prospa was a 2015 Telstra Business Awards finalist and rated 33rd globally as a leading innovator in KPMG's Fintech 100.

product.name: Prospa Small Business Loan
product.description: A fixed-term loan from $5K to $150K for small businesses to cover expenses or growth, repaid weekly with fixed interest rates and no upfront asset security required.

product.name: Prospa Business Loan Plus
product.description: A fixed-term loan from $150K to $500K for established businesses to fund larger expenses, requiring asset security and offering dedicated lending specialist support.

product.name: Prospa Business Line of Credit
product.description: A renewable 24-month credit facility up to $500K providing ongoing access to funds with interest charged only on the amount used, no upfront asset security required up to $150K.
